Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key and docs on doc_id to get pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter for target CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Cast activity_comment to NULL if it contains non-integer strings like 'Not Active'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
